improve-skill icon — every round, in order

Each tile is that round's candidate at 1024, rendered from the master the round produced. The 1024 composite is similarity to the raster reference; higher is closer, and it is a proxy rather than a verdict.
Green = rounds the blind panel preferred or that fixed a named defect. Red, faded = the eight rounds where the composite climbed while the panel preferred the previous take: the metric-chasing stretch you reverted.
